title: St Vincent and the Grenadines CIPO Business Registry Scraper

query.title: Entity name or registration number
query.description: A company or business name (or partial name), or a CIPO registration/entity number (e.g. 109/2003) to search for.

queries.title: Entity names or registration numbers
queries.description: Multiple names/registration numbers to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched entities to return per search query. The register's own search service caps results at 50 per query regardless of this setting.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search requests to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
